condition.zh: 頭痛 · 偏頭痛與紅旗

title.en: A night of headaches in the TCM clinic

tagline.zh: 一個十幾年都一樣的頭痛，和一個這輩子第一次的
tagline.en: One headache that has been the same for years, and one that is the first of its kind

desc.zh: 夜診主力：問診、脈舌、取穴、進針、寫病歷。每個頭痛先問一句：這次和以前一樣嗎？
desc.en: The evening clinic's workhorse: history, pulse and tongue, points, needles, notes. Every headache starts with one question: is this one like the others?

desc.zh: 生命徵象、留針觀察、轉診單與救護車都是你叫的。你的血壓計常常比醫師快。
desc.en: Vital signs, watching during retention, referral forms and the ambulance are yours. Your blood-pressure cuff is often faster than the doctor.

about.zh: 夜診守門人。每個頭痛都先問「這次和以前一樣嗎」，說這一句話救過的人比任何穴位都多。
about.en: Keeper of the evening clinic. Asks every headache “is this one like the others?” and says that question has saved more people than any point.

about.zh: 血壓計永遠在手邊。留針時會把燈調暗、把嘔吐袋放好，從不問為什麼。
about.en: Blood-pressure cuff always to hand. Dims the lamp and sets out a sick bag during retention without being asked.

role.zh: 四十五歲，月底結帳的偏頭痛

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。會計。十幾年來每到月底右側太陽穴跳痛、畏光、噁心，先兆是眼前的鋸齒光。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. An accountant. For over a decade, every month-end brings a throbbing right temple, light sensitivity and nausea, heralded by zigzag lights.

role.zh: 五十二歲，開車時突發劇痛
role.en: Fifty-two, sudden severe pain while driving

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。卡車司機，從來沒頭痛過。今天開車時後腦「像被人敲一棒」，脖子也硬了。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. A truck driver who has never had a headache. Today, while driving, the back of his head felt “hit with a bat”, and his neck went stiff.

about.zh: 會回電告訴你轉診的病人後來怎麼了。這種醫師不多。
about.en: Rings back to tell you what happened to the patient you referred. Not many do.

about.zh: 高中生。媽媽頭痛時負責把窗簾拉上、把家裡弄安靜。
about.en: A high-schooler. When her mother's head hurts she draws the curtains and keeps the house quiet.

plain.zh: 反覆發作、常單側搏動性的頭痛，伴畏光、噁心；多數人每次發作的樣子都很像。
plain.en: Recurrent, often one-sided throbbing headaches with light sensitivity and nausea; for most people every attack looks much the same.

plain.zh: 頭痛來之前出現的短暫神經症狀，例如眼前鋸齒狀閃光；偏頭痛病人常有固定的先兆。
plain.en: Brief nerve symptoms before the pain starts, such as zigzag flashes in the vision; migraine patients often have the same aura each time.

plain.zh: 依頭痛部位對應經絡：前額陽明、兩側少陽、後頭太陽、巔頂厥陰，再循經取穴。
plain.en: Mapping the site of the headache to a meridian: forehead Yangming, temples Shaoyang, occiput Taiyang, vertex Jueyin, then choosing points along it.

plain.zh: 膽經與三焦經，循行於頭的兩側；中醫認為側頭痛多與少陽經有關。
plain.en: The Gallbladder and Sanjiao meridians, which run along the sides of the head; in TCM temple headaches usually belong here.

plain.zh: 像按在琴弦上，端直而長；中醫認為多見於肝鬱、疼痛與痰飲。
plain.en: A pulse like a pressed violin string, straight and long; in TCM it accompanies liver constraint, pain and phlegm-fluid.

plain.zh: 中醫證型：情緒壓力使肝氣鬱而化火，陽氣上衝頭面，見頭痛、面紅、煩躁、弦脈、舌紅。
plain.en: A TCM pattern: stress constrains liver qi, which turns to heat and surges upward, giving headache, flushing, irritability, a wiry pulse and a red tongue.

plain.zh: 每條經脈上代表該臟腑原氣的穴位，例如肝經的太衝。
plain.en: The point on each meridian said to hold its organ's source qi, for example Taichong on the Liver meridian.

plain.zh: 針與皮膚約成四十五度角進針，用在肌肉薄或下方有重要器官的部位。
plain.en: Inserting the needle at roughly forty-five degrees to the skin, used where muscle is thin or something important lies beneath.

plain.zh: 腦幹最下段，管呼吸心跳；風池、風府深處就是它，針尖絕不可向上深刺。
plain.en: The lowest part of the brainstem, controlling breathing and heartbeat; it lies deep to Fengchi and Fengfu, so the needle must never be aimed upward and deep.

plain.zh: 突然在很短時間內達到最痛的劇烈頭痛，「這輩子最痛」；要當作腦出血處理，立即轉診急診。
plain.en: A severe headache that peaks within moments, “the worst of my life”; treated as a brain bleed until proven otherwise, with immediate emergency referral.

plain.zh: 提示可能有危險疾病的症狀或病史，看到就先轉診，不先做常規治療。
plain.en: A symptom or history that signals possible serious disease; when you see one, refer first and treat routinely later.

plain.zh: 在已得氣的針上夾導線，通以微弱電流；有心律調節器等植入電子裝置者禁用。
plain.en: Clipping leads to needles already at de qi and passing a weak current; forbidden with a pacemaker or other implanted electronic device.

plain.zh: 植入胸口、幫心臟維持節律的電子裝置；電針的電流可能干擾它。
plain.en: An electronic device implanted in the chest to keep the heart in rhythm; electroacupuncture current can interfere with it.

plain.zh: 記下每次發作的時間、先兆、誘因、睡眠、月經與用藥，複診時一起看。
plain.en: A record of each attack's time, aura, triggers, sleep, period and medicines, reviewed together at follow-up.

text.zh: 刻有經絡與穴位的人形教具。它不會喊痛、不會暈針，所以先在它身上找穴，再到病人身上核對體表標誌。
text.en: A human figure marked with meridians and points. It never complains or faints, so points are found here first and then confirmed on the patient's own landmarks.

text.zh: 十四經循行一覽。頭痛循經辨位的第一站：前額、兩側、後頭、巔頂各屬哪條經。
text.en: The fourteen meridians at a glance. First stop for channel-based localisation of a headache: which meridian owns the forehead, temples, occiput and vertex.

text.zh: 輸出先歸零再開機，導線同側成對夾在針柄上，由零慢慢調到病人可耐受的輕微跳動；取下前先歸零。心律調節器、癲癇、孕婦腹部禁用。
text.en: Output to zero before switching on, leads clipped in pairs on the same side, turned up from zero to a mild twitch the patient tolerates; back to zero before removing. Not with pacemakers, epilepsy or over a pregnant abdomen.

text.zh: 接近日光的燈色。看舌質顏色與苔色一定在這盞燈下，黃光會把淡舌看成紅舌。
text.en: Daylight-coloured light. Tongue body and coating colour are always read under it; a warm lamp turns a pale tongue red.

text.zh: 月底那一格永遠有字。日記讓誘因現形：睡眠、咖啡、月經、結帳。
text.en: The month-end square is never empty. The diary makes triggers visible: sleep, coffee, periods, the books.

text.zh: 先分外感與內傷：外感多急、伴惡寒發熱；內傷多反覆、與情緒飲食勞倦相關。再循經辨位選經，再依脈舌定證：弦而舌紅屬肝陽上亢，滑而苔膩屬痰濁，細弱而舌淡屬血虛，澀而舌紫屬瘀血。中醫認為治法隨證：平肝、化痰、補血、活血，取穴也跟著變。
text.en: First exterior versus interior: exterior headaches are acute with chills and fever; interior ones recur and track mood, diet and fatigue. Then localise by channel, then settle the pattern from pulse and tongue: wiry with a red tongue is liver yang rising, slippery with a greasy coat is phlegm, thin-weak with a pale tongue is blood deficiency, choppy with a purple tongue is stasis. In TCM the method follows the pattern, calming, transforming, nourishing or moving, and the points follow the method.

text.zh: 突發雷擊性、新發神經症狀（無力、言語不清、複視、意識改變）、發燒合併頸僵、外傷後、癌症或免疫低下病史、五十歲後新發、姿勢或用力時加劇、持續惡化。任何一項：先轉診急診，再談針灸。
text.en: Sudden thunderclap onset, new neurological signs (weakness, slurred speech, double vision, altered consciousness), fever with a stiff neck, after injury, cancer or immune suppression, new onset after fifty, worse with posture or straining, steadily progressive. Any one of these: emergency referral first, acupuncture later.

text.zh: 禁用：心律調節器與植入式電子裝置、癲癇病史慎用、孕婦腹腰部、心前區跨心臟通電、頸動脈竇附近。操作：輸出歸零再開、同側成對、慢慢調、不越過病人可耐受、取下前歸零。留針期間有人觀察。
text.en: Forbidden with pacemakers and other implanted electronics; caution in epilepsy; never over a pregnant abdomen or back, never across the heart, never near the carotid sinus. In practice: zero before on, pairs on the same side, turn up slowly, never beyond what the patient tolerates, zero before off. Someone watches throughout retention.

text.zh: 風池位於枕骨下、胸鎖乳突肌與斜方肌之間的凹陷。深處向上是延髓，外側有椎動脈。針尖朝鼻尖或對側眼球方向，依穴位標準深度，絕不可向上、向內深刺。
text.en: Fengchi lies below the occiput in the hollow between the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius. Upward and deep is the medulla; lateral is the vertebral artery. The tip points toward the nose or the opposite eye, to the point's standard depth, and never upward or inward and deep.

lines.zh: 中醫診間，下午四點半。日診剛散，夜診名單已經寫上白板。
lines.en: The TCM consulting room, half past four. Day clinic just emptied; the evening list is already on the board.

lines.zh: 淑芬月底又來了。還有一個初診，主訴頭痛。每個頭痛我都先問一句：這次和以前一樣嗎？
lines.en: Shu-Fen is back for month-end. And a new patient, complaint: headache. I ask every headache one thing first: is this one like the others?

lines.zh: 一樣的頭痛，是安心的頭痛？
lines.en: A headache like the others is a safe headache?

lines.zh: 比較安心。不一樣的，先當紅旗。去把銅人推過來。
lines.en: Safer. One unlike the others is a red flag until proven otherwise. Go and wheel the bronze figure over.

post.zh: 銅人不會喊痛，不會暈針。先在它身上找穴，再到人身上核對。
post.en: The bronze figure never complains and never faints. Find the points on him first, then confirm them on the person.

lines.zh: 頭痛循經辨位：前額陽明、兩側少陽、後頭太陽、巔頂厥陰。太陽穴怎麼找？
lines.en: Channel-based localisation for headache: forehead Yangming, temples Shaoyang, occiput Taiyang, vertex Jueyin. How do you find Taiyang?

lines.zh: 眉梢與外眼角之間向後約一橫指的凹陷。用病人的手指。
lines.en: The hollow about one finger-breadth behind the midpoint between the eyebrow tail and the outer canthus. Using the patient's finger.

post.zh: 指寸是病人的指，不是你的。你的手比淑芬大。
post.en: Finger-cun means the patient's finger, not yours. Your hand is bigger than Shu-Fen's.

note.zh: 淑芬：肝陽上亢，少陽取穴
note.en: Shu-Fen: liver yang rising, Shaoyang points

guide.en: Bring Shu-Fen to the pulse desk

sub.zh: 媽媽又頭痛了，窗簾我拉好了，拜託你們
sub.en: Mum's head again. Curtains are drawn. Please help her

lines.zh: 月底結帳，又來了。右邊太陽穴一跳一跳，看光會痛，想吐。
lines.en: Month-end closing, and here it is. Right temple throbbing, light hurts, I feel sick.

lines.zh: 這次和以前一樣嗎？
lines.en: Is this one like the others?

lines.zh: 一樣，十幾年了。先兆也一樣，眼前有鋸齒光。
lines.en: The same, for over ten years. Same aura too, zigzag lights.

lines.zh: 問得對。手伸出來。
lines.en: Right question. Hand out, please.

q.zh: 淑芬的脈像按在琴弦上，端直而長。這是？
q.en: Shu-Fen's pulse feels like a pressed violin string, straight and long. Which pulse?

why.zh: 弦主肝、主痛。月底壓力、煩躁、側頭跳痛，中醫認為是肝氣鬱而陽亢的脈。
why.en: Wiry belongs to the liver and to pain. Month-end stress, irritability and a throbbing temple: in TCM the pulse of constrained liver qi turning to rising yang.

why.zh: 浮緊是風寒在表，她沒有惡寒發熱。
why.en: Floating-tight means wind-cold on the exterior; she has no chills or fever.

why.zh: 細弱屬血虛，這條脈有力。
why.en: Thin-weak belongs to blood deficiency; this pulse is forceful.

why.zh: 滑脈如珠走盤，多見痰濕；她的脈是直的。
why.en: A slippery pulse rolls like beads, usually phlegm-damp; hers is straight.

guide.en: Read the tongue under the lamp

lines.zh: 舌在燈下看。黃光會騙人。
lines.en: Tongue under the lamp. Warm light lies.

q.zh: 舌紅、苔薄黃，配合弦脈、煩躁、壓力大。辨證？
q.en: Red body, thin yellow coat, with a wiry pulse, irritability and stress. The pattern?

why.zh: 弦脈、舌紅苔黃、情緒誘發、側頭痛，中醫認為是肝鬱化火、陽亢上擾清竅。
why.en: Wiry pulse, red tongue with yellow coat, triggered by stress, temple pain: in TCM constrained liver qi turning to fire and rising to disturb the head.

why.zh: 風寒應見苔薄白、惡寒、脈浮緊。
why.en: Wind-cold would show a thin white coat, chills and a floating-tight pulse.

why.zh: 痰濁多見頭重如裹、苔白膩、脈滑。
why.en: Phlegm gives a heavy wrapped head, a greasy white coat and a slippery pulse.

why.zh: 血虛舌淡、脈細、勞累後隱痛。
why.en: Blood deficiency shows a pale tongue, a thin pulse and a dull ache after exertion.

guide.en: Locate the points on the bronze figure

lines.zh: 側頭痛屬少陽經。局部兩個，遠端兩個。選哪四個？
lines.en: Temple pain belongs to the Shaoyang channel. Two local, two distal. Which four?

q.zh: 指出太陽、率谷、風池、太衝
q.en: Point to Taiyang, Shuaigu, Fengchi and Taichong

post.zh: 太衝是肝經原穴，中醫認為能平肝潛陽。風池呢？
post.en: Taichong is the Liver meridian's yuan-source point; in TCM it calms the liver and anchors yang. And Fengchi?
Toward the nose, never upward and deep.

guide.en: Practise the safe direction at Fengchi

lines.zh: 風池深處是延髓，外側是椎動脈。針尖向鼻尖或對側眼球，依穴位標準深度。
lines.en: Deep to Fengchi is the medulla, lateral is the vertebral artery. Tip toward the nose or the opposite eye, to the point's standard depth.

post.zh: 以前的醫師說這裡最有效。
post.en: My old doctor said this point works best.

post.zh: 最有效的穴，也是最要小心的穴。
post.en: The most effective point is also the one to be most careful with.

guide.zh: 到治療床斜刺率谷與太陽
guide.en: To the couch: oblique at Shuaigu and Taiyang

lines.zh: 頭皮下面是骨頭，所以率谷平刺、太陽斜刺。角度不對，針會頂在骨膜上，很痛。
lines.en: Bone lies under the scalp, so Shuaigu takes a transverse and Taiyang an oblique insertion. Wrong angle and the needle sits on periosteum, which hurts.

post.zh: 淑芬，留針的時候燈調暗一點好嗎？嘔吐袋在旁邊。
post.en: Shu-Fen, shall I dim the lamp while the needles are in? Sick bag's beside you.

guide.en: Agree the retention watch with Pan

lines.zh: 頭痛病人留針，看什麼？
lines.en: Headache patient with needles in: what do we watch?

lines.zh: 臉色、冒汗、噁心想吐，還有她說的每一句話。痛變了就叫我。
lines.en: Colour, sweating, nausea, and every word she says. If the pain changes, call me.

lines.zh: 血壓我也先量一次，放在旁邊。
lines.en: I'll take a blood pressure now too, and keep it handy.

note.zh: 建宏：雷擊性頭痛，轉診急診

lines.zh: 初診那位說他痛到站不住，我先讓他進來。
lines.en: The new patient says he can't stand for the pain. I brought him straight in.

lines.zh: 醫師，剛剛開車突然痛起來。這輩子沒這麼痛過。
lines.en: Doctor, it hit me suddenly while I was driving. Never had pain like this in my life.

lines.zh: 以前有偏頭痛嗎？這次和以前一樣嗎？
lines.en: Any migraines before? Is this one like the others?

lines.zh: 從來沒頭痛過。像被人從後面敲一棒。脖子也硬了。
lines.en: Never had a headache. Like being hit from behind with a bat. My neck's gone stiff too.

lines.zh: 你聽到了什麼？
lines.en: What did you just hear?

q.zh: 突發「這輩子最痛」、頸部僵硬、從無頭痛病史。下一步？
q.en: Sudden “worst of my life”, stiff neck, no headache history. Next step?

options.zh: 立即轉診急診，今晚不針
options.en: Emergency referral now; no needles tonight

why.zh: 雷擊性頭痛加頸僵是紅旗，要排除蜘蛛膜下腔出血。針灸不是不能，是現在不該。
why.en: A thunderclap headache with a stiff neck is a red flag for subarachnoid haemorrhage. Acupuncture is not forbidden; it is simply not for now.

options.zh: 先針風池試試能不能緩解
options.en: Try Fengchi first and see if it eases

why.zh: 緩解了也不代表安全，反而會延誤。紅旗先走轉診。
why.en: Easing would not make it safe, only delay it. Red flags go to referral first.

options.en: Check the blood pressure; needle if normal

why.zh: 血壓正常不能排除腦出血。病史本身已經夠了。
why.en: A normal blood pressure does not rule out a brain bleed. The history alone is enough.

lines.zh: 小潘量血壓時眉頭皺起來。建宏按著後腦，說看東西有點花。
lines.en: Pan frowns at the cuff. Jian-Hong holds the back of his head and says his vision is blurring.

options.zh: 停止治療，半坐臥，再量一次，叫救護車轉診
options.en: No treatment, semi-recumbent, repeat the reading, ambulance and referral

why.zh: 劇烈頭痛加高血壓加視力模糊，可能是出血的結果也可能是原因。急診的事交給急診，我們負責安全送達。
why.en: Severe headache, high blood pressure and blurred vision may be the result of a bleed or its cause. The emergency department's job is theirs; ours is getting him there safely.

options.en: Needle Taichong to bring the pressure down

why.zh: 這不是門診可以處理的血壓。先轉診，不要在診間花時間。
why.en: This is not a blood pressure for the clinic to manage. Refer; do not spend time in the consulting room.

why.zh: 止痛會遮住病程，也不是我們該開的藥。觀察的地方是急診。
why.en: Analgesia masks the course and is not ours to give here. The place to observe him is the emergency department.

post.zh: 紅旗加血壓，不用再討論了。轉診單，寫清楚時間。
post.en: Red flag plus that pressure: nothing more to discuss. Referral form, and write down the time it started.

lines.zh: 等救護車的時候，回答我：什麼樣的頭痛需要影像與急診？
lines.en: While we wait for the ambulance, tell me: which headaches need imaging and the emergency department?

question.zh: 哪些頭痛需要影像檢查與急診評估？
question.en: Which headaches need imaging and emergency assessment?

answer.zh: 突發雷擊性；新發神經症狀；發燒合併頸僵；外傷後；癌症或免疫低下；五十歲後新發；用力或姿勢加劇；持續惡化。建宏符合第一項就夠了。
answer.en: Thunderclap onset; new neurological signs; fever with a stiff neck; after injury; cancer or immune suppression; new after fifty; worse on straining or posture; steadily worsening. Jian-Hong meets the first, and that is enough.

post.zh: 頭痛的影像不是門診開的，是急診做的。我們的工作是認出紅旗。
post.en: Headache imaging is not ordered from here; it is done in the emergency department. Our job is to recognise the red flag.

lines.zh: 救護車快到了，轉診單我印好了。還要寫什麼？
lines.en: Ambulance is nearly here, referral printed. What else goes on it?

lines.zh: 突發劇烈頭痛、頸僵、視力模糊、血壓高、從無頭痛病史，還有開始的時間。
lines.en: Sudden severe headache, stiff neck, blurred vision, high blood pressure, no headache history, and the time it began.

lines.zh: 開始的時間最重要。急診每次都先問這個。
lines.en: The start time matters most. The emergency department always asks that first.

note.zh: 淑芬：電針教學，頭痛日記

lines.zh: 剛剛外面好像很忙？
lines.en: Sounded busy out there?

lines.zh: 有一位要去急診。妳的頭呢？
lines.en: Someone had to go to the emergency department. How is your head?

lines.zh: 輕一點了。還在跳，但是慢了。
lines.en: Lighter. Still throbbing, but slower.

lines.zh: 她頸肩也緊，率谷與風池一對，上電針。先問她一件事。
lines.en: Her neck and shoulders are tight too; Shuaigu and Fengchi as a pair, on electroacupuncture. First ask her one thing.

lines.zh: 淑芬，妳有沒有心律調節器或其他植入的電子裝置？
lines.en: Shu-Fen, do you have a pacemaker or any other implanted electronic device?

lines.zh: 沒有。我只有計算機。
lines.en: No. I only have a calculator.

steps.zh: 確認無心律調節器等禁忌
steps.en: Confirm no pacemaker or other contraindication

steps.zh: 針刺得氣後，同側成對夾導線
steps.en: After de qi, clip leads in same-side pairs
Output to zero, then switch on

steps.zh: 由零慢慢調到可耐受的輕微跳動
steps.en: Turn up slowly to a mild tolerable twitch

steps.zh: 留針期間觀察，不隨意加大
steps.en: Watch during retention; do not keep turning up

steps.zh: 先歸零關機，再取下導線出針
steps.en: Zero and off first, then remove leads and needles

lines.zh: 導線夾在針柄，不碰皮膚，不跨過正中線，不跨過心臟。
lines.en: Clips on the needle handle, not the skin; never across the midline, never across the heart.

lines.zh: 你今晚沒針建宏。有時候最好的一針，是不下的那一針。
lines.en: You did not needle Jian-Hong tonight. Sometimes the best needle is the one you do not use.

lines.zh: 你剛才想先針建宏。幸好小潘的血壓計比你快。記住：雷擊性頭痛，先轉診。
lines.en: You wanted to needle Jian-Hong first. Lucky Pan's cuff was quicker than you. Remember: thunderclap headache, refer first.

guide.en: Write the note, hand over the diary

lines.zh: 淑芬，這本頭痛日記：發作時間、先兆、睡眠、咖啡、月經、用藥，每次都記。
lines.en: Shu-Fen, this headache diary: time of attack, aura, sleep, coffee, period, medicines. Every time.

lines.zh: 月底一定會有一格。
lines.en: The month-end square will always be full.

lines.zh: 那就看看能不能讓它變小。
lines.en: Then let's see if we can make it smaller.

note.zh: 建宏：蜘蛛膜下腔出血，已會診

sub.zh: 建宏的電腦斷層出來了

lines.zh: 你們轉來的建宏，電腦斷層是蜘蛛膜下腔出血，神經外科已經接手。
lines.en: Jian-Hong, the one you sent: CT shows a subarachnoid haemorrhage. Neurosurgery has taken over.

lines.zh: 謝謝你回電。
lines.en: Thank you for ringing back.

lines.zh: 謝謝你們把開始的時間寫清楚。那是今晚最有用的一行字。
lines.en: Thank you for writing down the start time. Most useful line I read tonight.

lines.zh: 這通電話，比任何一針都重要。
lines.en: That phone call matters more than any needle.

lines.zh: 今晚兩個頭痛。一個十幾年都一樣，一個這輩子第一次。差別在哪裡？
lines.en: Two headaches tonight. One the same for over ten years, one the first of its life. Where was the difference?

lines.zh: 在那一句「這次和以前一樣嗎」。
lines.en: In the question: is this one like the others.

lines.zh: 對。穴位可以查書，那句話要變成習慣。回去睡覺，明天別頭痛。
lines.en: Yes. Points can be looked up; that question has to become a habit. Go and sleep. No headaches tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我把燈關了。嘔吐袋還剩很多。
lines.en: Lights off. Plenty of sick bags left.

sub.en: Is this one like the others?
